task: Fix 3 critical Populate/Classification bugs: Bug#1 - Populate stops working when ANY row is locked (should continue populating unlocked rows). Bug#2 - EQ Divider classification needs aggressive frequency filtering - hihats shouldn't have low/mid frequencies, kicks shouldn't have high frequencies. Need to reorganize misclassified samples. Bug#3 - Add ADSR envelope detection to classification - each drum type has expected attack/decay characteristics (kicks=fast attack long decay, hihats=fast attack fast decay, etc). Impacts on hihats makes no sense - need envelope-based filtering to prevent wrong classifications.
